0.why: src/common/core/LibAVR32Module.cpp:18-19 set triggerHighThreshold to 2.21 and triggerLowThreshold to 0.8, and this jack's voltage is passed to clockTrigger.process with that pair (WhiteWhaleModule.hpp:79, MeadowphysicsModule.hpp:83, AnsibleModule.hpp:89-92), whose held state is handed to the firmware as a GPIO line. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so only the first channel of a polyphonic cable reaches the firmware.

comment: Output index 0 is the clock output; indices 1 to 8 are the eight gate outputs. The panel prints clock, in and out in lower case and numbers the gate outputs 1 to 8 down two columns. The clock range of 1 second to 23ms and the division and multiplication limits come from docs/content/modules/meadowphysics.md.
